status: PLAN_ONLY; Monte Carlo, detector fitting and algorithm development NOT RUN
scope: One preregistered feasibility screen; no new defense, no parameter search, no reuse of G2/v4 test seeds

model.gain_policy: Recompute current nominal instantaneous all-links joint-covariance gains once for each H geometry; retain them for all network methods. Local uses the existing epsilon=0 gains. These are not optimal sparse-cache/gated gains.
model.reuse_disclosure: partial_H is the prior v4 pressure geometry, not a novel or unseen model; v4 main-edge FDI comparisons failed

communication.mode: common external periodic irregular schedule only
communication.header_bytes: not assumed zero; report payload only and separately state unmodelled identical protocol headers

attacks.dictionary: last 64 authentic packets actually sent and intercepted on target link; select before adding current authentic packet

rules.name: fixed_lag8
rules.selection: eighth most recent prior transmitted authentic packet; if fewer than eight exist use oldest; no skip when dictionary nonempty

rules.name: nearest_current_sender
rules.selection: minimum Euclidean distance from current authentic transmitted packet among prior dictionary packets; earliest stored index breaks ties; no skip

attacks.opportunity_policy: Both rules replace at every actual target-edge send inside attack interval. Report attempted replacement separately from changed payload. Never drop an opportunity from denominators.
allowed: prior actually transmitted authentic packets and times
attacks.comparison_warning: Common seeds, opportunities, rules and replacement counts do not imply identical Replay payloads across defense-dependent closed loops

normal_calibration.cap: 0.995 empirical quantile of raw healthy neighbor-difference norms in fit split, warmup removed; one shared cap per geometry
normal_calibration.residual_fit: Reuse current spatial empirical mean/covariance calibration on independent healthy data; fixed ridge rule from simulation/config.json
normal_calibration.unit: complete target-link cache-residency episode after warmup
normal_calibration.control_fit: At most 12 deterministic bisection iterations using normal threshold seeds and actual closed-loop gate dynamics; fit empirical 5% +/-0.5 percentage point if attainable. Freeze controls before pilot.
normal_calibration.risk_matching_audit: Report seed-cluster CIs and normal rejection/cap frequencies; if normal rejection risks differ by more than one percentage point or CI cannot establish comparability, do not claim matched-risk detection superiority

pilot.role: model-selection-free feasibility and fixed Gate-B diagnostic fitting only; no model/attack/threshold changes

confirm.role: independent confirmation of the same frozen gates; diagnostic coefficients frozen from pilot

eligibility.structural: Local observability/PBH and actual fixed-schedule augmented-cache matrix audit. Joint observability alone is insufficient.
eligibility.normal_raw_yang: Before attacks, deterministic covariance recursion under actual schedule and gains must be finite and PSD; receiver and network mean error traces in [350,399] must not exceed 1.10 times [300,349]. Finite-horizon eligibility only, not asymptotic proof.
eligibility.cooperation: Receiver healthy raw Yang mean MSE at state indices [51,200] at least 10% below local; seed-bootstrap lower CI for relative gain exceeds 10% in pilot and confirm.
eligibility.failure: Stop without changing A/H/topology/gains or weakening local baseline. Local random-walk growth at nondetectable nodes is not itself a defense failure.

metrics.state_index: update at t uses y(t), age-zero received packets and produces estimate(t+1); error windows refer to state/estimate indices
all: broadcasts, edge messages, payload bytes, runtime and storage
metrics.independent_unit: seed; all timestep/packet/episode summaries clustered within seed; methods and attack/clean runs paired by seed
metrics.recovery_definition: First 10 consecutive post-attack state indices with attacked receiver squared error <= own clean squared error + 0.10 times that method's pilot healthy MSE; pilot tolerance frozen for confirm. Report right censoring and restricted mean duration, never substitute zero for censored cases.
metrics.cache_exit: first real target-edge send after last replacement; age-zero received successor affects update immediately; report both nominal interval-end and actual cache-exit timing

gate_A.type: preregistered practical screen, not established result or publication-level efficacy test
gate_A.normalizer: D = partial-model raw Yang healthy receiver mean MSE at state indices [51,200], estimated within split; ratios of paired seed means, not mean of per-seed ratios
pass: cap-only healthy MSE cost vs raw <=5% of D (upper CI) and attack-minus-own-clean MSE >=20% of D (lower CI), for at least one frozen Replay rule
for the same rule, at least one of the two gated baselines reduces attack MSE vs cap-only by >=10% of D and raises healthy MSE vs cap-only by >=5% of D (both lower CIs)

for EACH gated baseline, a lower CI must establish at least one failure: healthy cost vs raw >5% of D, attack excess >10% of D, or recovery excess >10% of D. Merely failing to establish joint success is not evidence of a gap. If a baseline establishes all three upper bounds, it covers the scenario; if neither coverage nor failure is established, G3 is inconclusive and stops
same rule and same method contrast satisfy thresholds in pilot and confirm; all other outcomes remain reported
gate_A.inconclusive: CI crosses any required practical threshold: gate NOT PASSED, no seed expansion or alternative model search

gate_B.scope: Diagnostic evidence audit only; cap-only trajectories FIXED for both models and all rules, never select a method from results; no fusion weights, correction, isolation, new detector or defense performance claim
gate_B.candidate_rows: every target-link actual send r in [50,349], not only true attacks; decision d = next target-link send after r + 3 ticks, provided d<=379
gate_B.base_features: legal local innovation, received-payload-minus-local-estimate, previous-payload dynamic difference, receive gap at r; use vectors and squared norms, fixed scaling from normal fit split
gate_B.extra_features: four local innovation vectors at next-send..next-send+3 and four age-aligned other-incoming-neighbor cache-minus-local-estimate vectors at those times; all available by d, no private neighbor estimates or additional messages
gate_B.offline_target: paired attacked-minus-own-clean receiver squared estimation error at d; truth and healthy counterfactual used ONLY for offline scoring/diagnostic training, never features or deployment inputs
gate_B.diagnostic: standard linear ridge regression with intercept, standardized columns, fixed penalty 1. Pilot uses leave-one-SEED-out fits (23 train, one held-out; normal-fit standardization fixed), never in-sample loss. If pilot gates pass, refit both diagnostics on all 24 pilot seeds, freeze coefficients and evaluate independent confirm seeds. No feature/model/hyperparameter selection. An ordinary regression diagnostic is not a new method.
gate_B.pass: At least 10% reduction in out-of-sample seed-weighted squared prediction loss for actual harm vs base features in BOTH pilot leave-one-seed-out and independent confirm, paired lower CI >10%, on the same Replay rule that passed A; also exhibit nonzero noise-whitened added sensitivity of actual augmented attack-to-local/received-output map. Conditional evidence is only relative to these frozen features, not all possible estimators.
gate_B.known_event_caution: Matrix impulse tests may fix a candidate event for mechanism checks; empirical diagnostic processes all candidate rows and does not receive actual attack source/index. This does not establish unknown-link localization or recover original payload.
gate_B.information_limitation: H1 A^ell e1=0 physically. Network feedback sensitivity may differ. Received neighbor histories are correlated and may be polluted, not trusted automatically.
gate_B.inconclusive: No added causal information, insufficient support or CI crosses threshold => gate NOT PASSED; no new module

inference.bootstrap_unit: paired seed; equal seed weight even when candidate counts differ
gate_A_family: cap attack excess for each rule (2)
each gate normal cost vs raw (2)
each gate normal cost vs cap (2)
cap-minus-gate attacked MSE for each gate/rule (4)
each gate own-clean attack excess by rule (4)
each gate own-clean recovery excess by rule (4)
inference.intervals: Gate A uses all 19 contrasts and both rules, Bonferroni percentile intervals of level 1-0.05/19 each (two-sided), recomputing ratio-of-means normalizer per resample. Gate B uses 97.5% per-rule intervals. Do not drop unfavorable contrasts or change multiplicity after results.
inference.pilot_B_resampling: Resample paired seed identities and RECOMPUTE the complete leave-one-seed-out procedure per replicate; copies of the same original held-out seed must all be excluded from training, using bootstrap multiplicity weights. Do not treat fixed cross-fit prediction rows as independent or ignore diagnostic fitting uncertainty. Confirm bootstraps seeds with pilot coefficients fixed.
inference.small_sample_limit: Screening evidence only. Insufficient CI precision is not a pass; no 1% improvement or 1% power claim. A formal later study would require a new paired-method estimand and separate power calculation.

stop: strong baselines already cover normal/attack/recovery tradeoff
A or B inconclusive or failed
benefit needs oracle location/original payload/extra information
future_artifacts: new Run ID under reviews/g3_partial_observability/results/; immutable config, code hashes, seeds, full per-seed results, packet records, censoring, failures and source permissions
